summary: Implemented the rich_measure for Tree and VerticalCenter feature by reading and editing files only; no tests were run and nothing was committed. Changes: rich/tree.py adds Tree.__rich_measure__ (iterative stack walk, indent 4 per level); rich/align.py adds Align.__repr__, an Align width constraint (measured max, or min of measured max and explicit width), and a new public VerticalCenter class with render, measure and repr; rich/console.py print now passes justify="default" to render options while still passing justify to _collect_renderables; CHANGELOG.md marks 9.8.0 unreleased with an Added subheading and two entries; tests added in tests/test_align.py (repr, VerticalCenter render, measure) and tests/test_tree.py (tree measurement expecting Measurement(11, 19)). Not yet verified: whether the existing Align tests still pass after the width constraint change, since test_align_width and centering tests are the most likely to be affected. Running the test suite is needed to confirm.
